Orange Cheese Souffle
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 11:25pm

Ingredients




1 stick butter
4 eggs
1/2 teaspoon sugar
Pinch of salt
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 1/2 cups sour cream
1/2 cup orange juice
12 frozen blintzes

Preparation

1 Butter 9x13 pan. Line with blintz. Put the other ingredients into blender until smooth. Pour over mixture. Bake at 375 degrees for 1/2 hour. Turn down to 350 degrees for 3/4 hour. Check after 1/2 hour. Good brunch dish.
